Sub HighlightTargetSums()
    Const LOW_TARGET As Double = 994108
    Const HIGH_TARGET As Double = 994112

    Dim rng As Range, c As Range
    Dim vals() As Double, refs() As Range
    Dim used() As Boolean

    For Each c In rng.Cells
        If IsNumeric(c.Value) And Len(c.Value) > 0 Then

            ReDim Preserve refs(1 To n)
            vals(n) = CDbl(c.Value)
            Set refs(n) = c
            c.Interior.Pattern = xlNone
        End If
    Next c

    If n = 0 Then Exit Sub
    ReDim used(1 To n)

    FindCombos vals, refs, used, 1, 0#, LOW_TARGET, HIGH_TARGET
End Sub

Private Sub FindCombos(ByRef vals() As Double, ByRef refs() As Range, _
                       ByRef used() As Boolean, ByVal idx As Long, _
                       ByVal runningTotal As Double, _
                       ByVal lowTarget As Double, ByVal highTarget As Double)

    Dim i As Long

    If runningTotal >= lowTarget And runningTotal <= highTarget Then
        For i = LBound(used) To UBound(used)
            If used(i) Then refs(i).Interior.Color = RGB(0, 176, 80)
        Next i

    used(idx) = False
    FindCombos vals, refs, used, idx + 1, runningTotal, lowTarget, highTarget
End Sub"""
